nodes.sub: game design doc · with a carbon, record 0017

nodes.text: A one-page GDD cover sheet, paper-clipped to the carbon of something else.

Imagine an adventure game taken to the next level, a fractal cinematic narrative video-game, a mature blend of old school point-and-click investigation, coupled with a new and unique gameplay mechanic.
Retinal Burn follows a film student/historian tasked with uncovering the long lost silent film of Austrian auteur Stefan Stutgart.

Starting with a tutorial in the academic world, the player embarks upon a globetrot to rediscover the missing film reels, encountering a wide range of shady entrepreneurs and filmland eccentrics and royalty.
record 0017. re: cross reference: Miranda Fromme, meeting, facade
Stutgart arrives at the cafe. Mrs. Fromme in attendance with youngest child. Fromme offers seat across from self, child colors with crayons at table. Stutgart orders a drink off the menu.
The carbon is numbered 0017 of a run. There is no 0016 in the drawer and no 0018. Whoever typed it struck the S of Stutgart hardest.
